# Module `lune_ui_core::drag`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core`](index.md)

In-window drag and drop (`infra.drag-and-drop`): pointer tracking only, never the OS drag API.

Two pure state machines and the glue that feeds them from a frame:

- [`ReorderDrag`](drag.md#struct.ReorderDrag) reorders items along one axis (a strip of tabs, a row of chips). A press arms
  it, 4 px of horizontal travel starts the drag, the dragged item follows the pointer while a
  target slot and every other item's offset are recomputed, and an edge zone auto-scrolls the
  strip. The shape is a port of the reference tab-strip controller: indices and widths in, an
  offset per item out.
- [`FreeDrag`](drag.md#struct.FreeDrag) is the two-axis form (a board of columns of cards): 4 px of Euclidean travel
  starts it and the target is a column and an insertion index.

Both are plain data with no clock: the auto-scroll takes the frame's `dt`, never a timer.
Totality is a contract: NaN or infinite coordinates, zero or negative widths, an empty list and an
out-of-range index never panic and answer "not dragging, all offsets zero, delta zero".

The glue is [`Ui::drag_gesture`](ui.md#method.Ui.drag_gesture) (and [`Ui::free_drag_gesture`](ui.md#method.Ui.free_drag_gesture)): it reads the item's
[`Response`](ui.md#struct.Response), feeds the machine, cancels on Escape (through
[`Ui::consume_key_while_pressed`](ui.md#method.Ui.consume_key_while_pressed), so Escape with nothing in flight is not consumed), on capture
loss, on a button up that reported no release and on a change of the item count, and asks for a
frame while the auto-scroll delta is non-zero. The item's hit region must sense a drag
([`Sense::DRAG`](ui.md#associatedconstant.Sense.DRAG)). Coordinates in the glue are window coordinates in
logical pixels, as [`Response::press_pos`](ui.md#structfield.Response.press_pos) and [`Ui::pointer_pos`](ui.md#method.Ui.pointer_pos) report them.

Motion (`Ui::drag_offset`): a neighbour slides to its new slot (`move`, `fast`, `sine-in-out`),
the dragged item has no transition, and after a release it settles into its slot (`settle`, 180
ms in the Full tier, a snap in Reduced and Off). Auto-scroll is never eased.

**Methods and associated items**

`impl ReorderDrag`

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.auto_scroll_delta"></a>`pub fn auto_scroll_delta(&self) -> f64`

  Signed scroll to add to the strip this tick (per [`AUTO_SCROLL_TICK`](drag.md#constant.AUTO_SCROLL_TICK)); 0 when idle.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.auto_scroll_step"></a>`pub fn auto_scroll_step(&self) -> f64`

  The scroll to apply this frame: [`Self::auto_scroll_delta`](drag.md#method.ReorderDrag.auto_scroll_delta) scaled by the `dt` of the last
  [`Self::tick`](drag.md#method.ReorderDrag.tick); 0 before any tick.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.cancel"></a>`pub fn cancel(&mut self)`

  Clears every trace of the gesture, the offsets and any running settle. Idempotent.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.dragged_index"></a>`pub fn dragged_index(&self) -> Option<usize>`

  The index the drag started from, while dragging.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.dragged_left"></a>`pub fn dragged_left(&self) -> f64`

  The dragged item's clamped left edge in strip content coordinates; 0 when not dragging.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.is_active"></a>`pub fn is_active(&self) -> bool`

  Armed or dragging.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.is_armed"></a>`pub fn is_armed(&self) -> bool`

  Pressed on an item but still under the threshold.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.is_dragging"></a>`pub fn is_dragging(&self) -> bool`

  The threshold has been crossed and the drag is live.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.new"></a>`pub fn new() -> Self`

  An idle machine.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.offsets"></a>`pub fn offsets(&self) -> &[f64]`

  Every item's horizontal offset, index-aligned with the widths; all zero when not dragging.
  The dragged item's entry tracks the pointer; every other entry is the exact difference
  between that item's slot now and its slot in the reordered layout.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.press"></a>`pub fn press(&mut self, index: usize, content_x: f64, viewport_x: f64, m: &Metrics<'_>)`

  Arms a gesture on item `index`. Records the threshold origin and the grab offset, but does
  not start a drag; activating the item is the caller's job.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.release"></a>`pub fn release(&mut self) -> DropResult`

  Ends the gesture and reports what it meant; all state is cleared before it returns, so the
  indices travel in the result.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.target_index"></a>`pub fn target_index(&self) -> Option<usize>`

  The index the dragged item would land in on release, while dragging.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.tick"></a>`pub fn tick(&mut self, dt: Duration, m: &Metrics<'_>) -> bool`

  An auto-scroll tick over `dt` of frame time: the pointer has not moved but the content under
  it has, so the content position is re-derived as `viewport_x + metrics.offset`. The scroll
  to apply (`auto_scroll_step`) is the per-tick delta scaled by `dt / 16 ms`. Returns whether
  a drag is live.

- <a id="method.ReorderDrag.update"></a>`pub fn update(&mut self, content_x: f64, viewport_x: f64, m: &Metrics<'_>) -> bool`

  Feeds a new pointer position (`content_x` in strip content coordinates, `viewport_x` in the
  strip viewport's). Crosses the threshold when the horizontal travel reaches
  [`DRAG_THRESHOLD`](drag.md#constant.DRAG_THRESHOLD) (a vertical wobble stays a click), then recomputes the target, the offsets
  and the auto-scroll delta. Returns whether a drag is live.

**Variants**

- <a id="variant.DropResult.None"></a>`None`

  Nothing was in flight.

- <a id="variant.DropResult.Click"></a>`Click`

  The item already activated on press; there is nothing further to do.

<a id="fn.drop_index"></a>

```rust
pub fn drop_index(card_mids: &[f64], pointer_y: f64) -> usize
```

The insertion index for a pointer at `pointer_y`: the number of `card_mids` above it. NaN mids
and a non-finite pointer count nothing.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/drag.rs:471`

```rust

```

The first column whose range `[x, x + w)` holds `pointer_x`, with the insertion index at
`pointer_y`; `None` outside every column or for a non-finite pointer.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/drag.rs:477`

<a id="fn.edge_step"></a>
### Function `edge_step`

```rust
pub fn edge_step(p: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64, can_lo: bool, can_hi: bool) -> f64
```

The auto-scroll delta per [`AUTO_SCROLL_TICK`](drag.md#constant.AUTO_SCROLL_TICK) of a pointer at `p` over the viewport `lo..hi`:
negative within [`AUTO_SCROLL_ZONE`](drag.md#constant.AUTO_SCROLL_ZONE) of `lo` while `can_lo`, positive within it of `hi` while
`can_hi`, ramping linearly to [`AUTO_SCROLL_MAX`](drag.md#constant.AUTO_SCROLL_MAX) at the edge and past it; else 0, also for a
coordinate that is not finite.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/drag.rs:440`

### Function `paint_drop_line`

```rust
pub fn paint_drop_line<H: Copy + PartialEq>(p: &mut Painter<'_, H>, rect: Rect, theme: &Theme)
```

Paints the drop line: [`DROP_LINE_THICKNESS`](drag.md#constant.DROP_LINE_THICKNESS) tall, `accent`, across `rect`'s width and centred
